domain: Political Economy / Labor Systems / Embodied Resistance
topic_summary: Analysis of a narrative depicting labor under pervasive surveillance and bodily transformation, where a worker discovers an alternative communication substrate (stone resonance) that operates outside institutional monitoring systems. The protagonist's crystalline lattice intrusions enable access to frequencies the compliance apparatus cannot detect, creating conditions for unsanctioned knowledge transmission.

key_entities: Protagonist (worker with progressive lattice intrusions; develops stone-resonance capacity)
Elder (demonstrates unsanctioned practice; models alternative knowledge transmission)
Scuttlers (marine organisms; congregation behavior indicates substrate signal)
Compliance scan (behavioral monitoring system; measures deviation from work rhythm)
Stone/ferrocrete substrate (communication medium; carries layered hum below institutional frequency)
key_tensions: Sanctioned vs unsanctioned knowledge transmission (nest-touch murmur vs stone resonance)
Institutional time vs embodied time (quota pulse vs body's own intervals)
Monitored labor vs unmonitored practice (compliance scan coverage vs eastern margin gaps)
key_mechanisms: Lattice intrusion progression (enables resonance capacity; transforms body into receiver)
Compliance scan (monitors work rhythm; enforces behavioral uniformity)
Stone resonance transmission (operates below institutional detection threshold; carries accumulated signal)
absences: No explanation of lattice origin or institutional response to intrusions
No account of what happened to the disposed worker or why disposal occurred

omegas.description: Is bodily_transformation_as_receiver_construction a Mountain (inevitable physical process) or Piton (institutional intervention)? Narrative provides no account of lattice origin or institutional response to intrusions.
What behavioral deviation triggered disposal protocol for named worker? Absence of explanation leaves enforcement boundary undefined, affecting risk calculation for unsanctioned practice.

Is elder an isolated practitioner or node in larger counter-institutional network? Narrative shows transmission to protagonist but not network topology.
